rows.feature: hollow(shape,{open:word}) on a shape with a reflex edge (stepped join, blind hole, channel/pocket): face pick is right, shell volume is not
rows.evidence: WRONG, builds without any sentence. cmd: bun secL.mjs, secM.mjs, euclid.mjs. Stepped union (box 40x30x10 + box 20x20x10 on top), wall 2: open top SolidCraft V=7312.000 vs OCCT 7253.994 (dVol 8.0e-3, faces 21 vs 25); open bottom 5952.000 vs 5893.994 (9.8e-3); open right 7512.000 vs 7453.994 (7.8e-3); plate with a 4-deep blind hole, open bottom 4763.306 vs 4733.376 (6.3e-3); plate with a through channel, open bottom 2532.000 vs 2519.982 (4.8e-3). Diagnosis: SolidCraft uses plane-offset (my closed form for the stepped union is exactly 7312.000 = SolidCraft); OCCT offsets true surfaces and rounds the cavity at the reflex edge. An independent voxel Euclidean-erosion estimator (euclid.mjs, h=0.1) gives 7249.7 for the stepped union, matching OCCT (7253.994, 6e-4) not SolidCraft (8.6e-3 away). The pick itself is right: mirrored-pick control rejected (dCOM 5.3e-2). Shells of boxes (dVol 1e-16), plates with a through hole (5.3e-6) and cylinders (9e-5, tessellation) are unaffected. Same family as the plane-offset convention noted in phase7/README.md and fuzz/README.md; the shell-draft group should own the fix (refuse any shell whose cavity meets a reflex edge).

rows.feature: topoRefs()/dependsOn(): names create dependencies; orphanedBy, withoutFeatures, danglingRefs, firstOrderViolation
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secJ.mjs (kernel independent, plus the translator cascade). round1 (edge between carried pull1 +z and swept pull2 edge1): topoRefs=[pocket1,pull1,pull2], dependsOn=[pocket1,pull1,pull2]. orphanedBy(pull1)=[pull1,pocket1,round1,shell1]; orphanedBy(sk2)=[sk2,pull2,pocket1,round1,shell1]; danglingRefs after a raw delete of pull2 lists pocket1 and round1; whyDeletingCosts(pull2): "pocket1, round1 and shell1 are built from pull2, so they go too.". Translator cascade: a refused upstream feature refuses its dependents with a pointer ("shell1 (shell): its target pull1 was refused (pull1 (extrude): the midplane option is not mapped in phase 0 ...)"); the nested text grows with every dependent.

rows.feature: param(name, value, {min,max,step,caption}): declaration, defaults, each name once, errors
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secP.mjs (script layer, kernel independent). param('w',40) -> namedParams {caption:'w', min:0, max:160, step:1, slots:['box1_width']}; with opts {min:20,max:80,step:5,caption:'Width'} they are carried to params panel. Duplicate name: "param() already used the name "w" earlier in this script. Give each one its own name.". Non-numeric value: "param's value has to be a number, and you gave it the text "abc"."; non-string name: "param() needs a name first: param("wall", 2). You gave it 5."; unknown option: "param has no option called "color". It takes min, max, step, caption."; non-integer count: "repeat(): count has to be a whole number of at least 1 -- got 3.5.". Gaps (accepted silently, no sentence): min > max (min 50, max 10) and a default outside [min,max] (100 in [20,80]); toScript(doc, namedParams) round trips to the same doc and params.

rows.feature: applyParam / runScript({values}) re-evaluate geometry numerically on SolidCraft (param feeding box, round, hollow, hole, pocket offset, draft, sketch rule value)
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secE.mjs, secP2.mjs. 22 runScript({values}) variants of 5 param scripts: 21 PASS vs OCCT/brep-rs, 1 honest refusal (above). Sketch rule bound to param L1 (sk1_rule9-value) = 30/45/12 -> SolidCraft V=3000.000000/4500.000000/1200.000000 (expected 3000/4500/1200, dVol <= 2.8e-12). Out-of-range values are applied without a clamp or sentence: box width 500 (declared max 80) builds V=300000; width -5 builds V=3000 (the size is read as 5, same in OCCT; brep-rs reads it as 1000); width 0 and 1e-9 REFUSED by solidcraft: "box1 (box): solidcraft refused it -- solid.box: invalid input: box needs a positive size in x, y and z"; an unknown values key is ignored silently (box stays 40 wide); NaN falls back to the default.

rows.feature: generatedParams slots of intersect(box, sphere) and ring1_z: SolidCraft bbox/face report disagrees with OCCT, volume agrees
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secG.mjs, bun exp7.mjs. 7 slots flagged FAIL by the harness, all with dVol <= 1.5e-4 (inside the 3e-4 curved bar) and dCOM <= 3.7e-6. Cause for 6: the OCCT bbox (AddOptimal) is looser than the geometry: intersect result x-max reads 16.0004 / 19.58 although the box face is at 15 / 18.75, SolidCraft reports 15.0 / 18.75 (the correct values, because the result lies inside the box); ring1_z: dBbox 4.5e-4 is tessellation of the torus against the |b|>=1 scale floor. One case (box height 12.5) reports 8 faces (4 'cone', 3 plane, 1 sphere) against OCCT's 4 (3 plane, 1 sphere): exp8.mjs shows the 4 extra faces are slivers of 0.348 mm2 each (1.4 mm2 of ~2200 mm2) where the sphere meets the box edges. Independent check: the exact volume of ball(r15 at x=5) intersect box 30x30x12.5 by 1-D integration is 7489.2049 (exp9.mjs) = OCCT 7489.2049; SolidCraft 7488.8459 (4.8e-5, tessellation). So the solid is right; why truck splits off the slivers is not explained.

rows.feature: model-handles size handles (box width/depth/height, cylinder across/height, cone, sphere, ring tube, extrude height, datum offset, draft angle) on unturned shapes
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secI.mjs, bun secI2.mjs (handlesFor on the doc; SolidCraft body from translator + model.faces/edges). Handle origin lies on the SolidCraft bbox extreme along its axis: 8/8 (exact for box 0.0; curved <= 6.5e-4 = tessellation). Simulated drag d=3 along the axis with the handle's scale: SolidCraft's extreme moves 3.0000 (box exact, cylinder/cone 2.9998-3.0000), and the dragged doc matches live OCCT in every case (32/32 size drags PASS; max dVol 1.8e-4). Pocket depth handle sits on the pocket floor plane (z=6, planar face of the SolidCraft body) and extrude height handle on the cap.

rows.feature: model-handles move arrows (x/y/z) and turn handles (rx/ry/rz): drag changes the SolidCraft solid like OCCT
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secI.mjs. move: 36 drags (box, cylinder, cone, ring, sphere, move feature, fillet/draft chains) -> 35 PASS, the 1 non-PASS is ring z (dBbox 4.5e-4 torus tessellation, dVol 1.5e-4); SolidCraft's extreme moves exactly 3.0000 for a 3.0 drag. turn: 9 drags (box, cylinder, cone, turned) all PASS vs OCCT (max dVol 1.8e-4). Move arrows sit offset out from the part by design (not on the solid).

rows.feature: model-handles on a turned shape: handle positions ignore the rotation
rows.evidence: cmd: bun secI.mjs. box 40x30x20 turned [0,0,15]: the width and depth handles are computed from centre +/- size/2 without the rotation, so they float 3.20 mm and 4.67 mm off the SolidCraft solid's extreme (unturned: 0.0). Dragging the width handle by 3 moves the solid's extreme by 2.8978 not 3.0000; the height handle (along the turn axis) is exact. Same for a turned cylinder/cone. The param change itself matches OCCT (PASS), so the SOLID is right; only the handle position is wrong (rotation not mapped, no sentence). Kernel independent (the same doc arithmetic is used for every engine); reported because the handle is the interaction surface on turned parts.

rows.feature: model-handles sketch corner point handles, corner round (radius) handle, fillet radius handle
